name: QuadBox
definition: A Gaussian-tile intersection method that uses four axis-aligned bounding boxes (AABBs) to tightly encapsulate projected 2D Gaussians, reducing tile over-approximation and redundant computations in the rasterizer preprocess stage.
summary: QuadBox is a Gaussian-tile intersection method using four adaptive axis-aligned bounding boxes to tightly encapsulate projected 2D Gaussians, reducing over-approximation and redundant computations.
